summary.headline: Paisalo Q1 FY27: record disbursement of Rs.17,309 million (+128% YoY), PAT up 30% to Rs.613 million, gross NPA 0.70%.
summary.overview: Management, represented solely by Deputy MD Santanu Agarwal (CFO unavailable), reported AUM of Rs.67,074 million (+28% YoY) and a record quarterly disbursement of Rs.17,309 million. Total income rose 19% YoY to Rs.2,603 million and PAT rose 30% YoY to Rs.613 million, with gross NPA at 0.70% and net NPA at 0.49%. Management set a three-year ambition to roughly double AUM, income and profitability, and launched a Rs.300 crore NCD tranche under a Rs.900 crore shelf. Sequential metrics were weaker in several places: interest expense rose and opex fell sharply QoQ, and loan-loss provisions jumped, which management attributed to timing and settlement effects.

financial_highlights.change: expected to stay slightly higher short term

segments.name: Lending (MSME / micro-enterprise)
segments.commentary: AUM mix in Q1: food and hospitality about 23%, agri and allied agri about 15%, street vendors about 16%; vehicle, health, education and textile each about 3-6%. Internal cap is 25% per industry.

segments.name: Distribution
segments.commentary: Touch points rose to 5,995 across 23 states from 5,299 a quarter earlier (+696 over four quarters per management). BC franchise crossed USD 1 billion gross transaction value.

segments.name: New product lines
segments.commentary: Six new product lines added in the last quarter across mobility, industrial, medical, agri equipment and alternative fuel; too early to set mix targets.

guidance_outlook: Ambition to approximately double AUM, income and profitability over three fiscal years.
Quarterly growth may normalise from the high base, but management expects healthy momentum through FY27.
Cost-to-income ratio to stay slightly higher in the short to medium term during the AI transition.
Co-lending with SBI remains at status quo, awaiting compliance on the bank side; treated as optionality not included in guidance.
Three new development products to launch around end-Q3 FY27; AI outbound calling for new-to-Paisalo customers to start around then.
Internal leverage comfort around 3.5x against a regulatory limit of 7x; about $44 million of FCCBs pending conversion, with a committee meeting scheduled.
risks_watch: Interest cost (Rs.115 crore per the questioner's reading, up from Rs.87 crore QoQ) and sharp opex fall (Rs.69 crore to Rs.46 crore) partly unexplained; management cites timing lag between funding and deployment.
Loan-loss provisions up sharply QoQ (about 120% per the questioner); management attributes this to settlement timing.
Collection efficiency 97.5%, reportedly down about 1% QoQ.
Leverage (debt-to-equity 2.61x) rising; headroom depends on FCCB conversion and the NCD issue.
Co-lending with SBI stalled pending bank compliance; RBI co-lending and collateral-free rule changes need to be operationalised.
New product lines (six added recently) have short track records; risks not yet quantified.
Management declined to disclose new-to-Paisalo AI outbound conversion metrics until around end-Q3 FY27.
summary.management_tone: Confident and promotional on growth, distribution and AI; repeated the 'strongest quarter yet' framing. Evasive or deflecting on sequential cost, interest and provision questions, which were answered with timing explanations and without quantified guidance.
